description: Use when the traveler has chosen a plan and wants to buy it. Returns a link straight to the checkout confirmation screen with the plan and days filled in. The traveler pays there themselves (no account or app needed, just an email address); this tool never takes payment. The QR code and one-tap install link are emailed and shown in My Page right after payment.

days.description: Trip length in days. Needed for daily plans (sets how many days are bought); ignored for fixed-GB plans.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

plan_id.description: Required. The plan_id of the chosen plan, from recommend_plan or search_plans.

name: get_purchase_link
title: Get checkout link
